pages.title: §lTier Probability Mechanics
pages.text: Affix tiers are determined by multiple factors:$(br)• §bEnchantability§7: Higher enchantment value increases chance for high-tier affixes$(br)• §bMaterial Bonuses§7: Enchanting materials can significantly boost tier probabilities$(br)• §bPity System§7: Consecutive low-tier rolls accumulate luck$(br)• §bExisting Affixes§7: Having a high-tier affix slightly increases upgrade chance

The system uses §dLinear Normalization§7 to calculate probability distribution for each tier.$(br2)You can view real-time tier probabilities in the Super Smithing Table GUI.$(br2)Using better enchanting materials greatly increases the chance of obtaining high-tier affixes.
